local cpu=manager.machine.devices[':maincpu']
local space=cpu.spaces['program']
audio_tap=space:install_write_tap(0xdc00,0xdc0b,'boot-audio-init',function(a,d,m)
 local pc=cpu.state['PC'].value
 if pc>=0x54b1 and pc<=0x5548 then print(string.format('[AUDIO] pc=%04x addr=%04x value=%04x mask=%04x',pc,a,d,m)) end
end)
